_comment: The verified source of truth for every resume the Tailor builds (§5, §10).
Write these yourself, in your own words, with real numbers. The Tailor may
reorder and lightly reword them; it may never add to them. strength is your
own 1-5 rating and it decides which bullets get retrieved at all.

bullets.text: Built a retrieval pipeline over 40k internal documents that cut median lookup time from 11s to 1.4s.
Wrote the evaluation harness that caught a 12% precision regression before it shipped.
